value.rationale: The natural well-bicovered property asks for the cardinalities of all maximal induced bipartite graphs, not merely the maximum. This theorem supplies the complete labeled distributions and a sharp parity dichotomy for the canonical vertex-transitive triangular graphs, plus exact inclusion-minimal odd-cycle-transversal counts and an asymptotic 2/3 split. These are meaningful structural and enumerative answers not implied by prior generic enumeration algorithms.
